content_sections.heading: CUJ Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CUJ Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CUJ Assistant Professor Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CUJ Assistant Professor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 2 for Assistant Professor (Temporary).

content_sections.heading: CUJ Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: B. E. / B. Tech. / B. S. and M. E. / M. Tech. / M. S. or Integrated M. Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees. OR Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with MCA.

content_sections.heading: CUJ Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUJ to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUJ Assistant Professor (Temporary) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CUJ Assistant Professor (Temporary) positions is 21 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor (Temporary) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Temporary) post at the Central University of Jharkhand (CUJ) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor (Temporary) position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification includes a B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in a relevant branch with first class, or a Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with an MCA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Temporary) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor (Temporary) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 57,700 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor (Temporary) positions at CUJ will be based on a Walk-In-Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CUJ Assistant Professor (Temporary) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-In-Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-In-Interview will be conducted at the Central University of Jharkhand, Ranchi, Jharkhand. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor position is on a temporary and contractual basis, as indicated by the job type and post name.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Jharkhand apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Jharkhand. It is advisable to check the official notification for specific domicile requirements or eligibility for candidates from other states.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of the Central University of Jharkhand?
faq.answer: The official website of the Central University of Jharkhand is www.cuj.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates regarding the recruitment.
